benchmark: M5 Benchmark v2 - guided non-anatomical surface-seam sheet
scope: Separate opt-in visual development on the original scene; not an amendment to old reports or signed gates. Only seam_mode=surface with guide_band_m=0.0001 is admitted. Keep the original mechanical, RCM, collision, tension, tear, farthest severed row and sweep limits.
acquisition: Use v7 retained full-face inks as a separate post-bite diagnostic. Use the existing geometrically bound cell-certificate v2 print and reader in the narrow review. Never fuse the two exposures. Narrow RGB-D alone must certify a connected prefix from row zero to the unique observed transition and positive intact boundary. Do not use local-only labels, registered jaw count, structural cut length or wide-view marker pose as features. Inject the registered work noise amplitude into narrow depth with an independent SeedSequence(case_seed,tick,513).
control: The unchanged v4 visual 6 mm arm only schedules a review. Require genuine closed jaws and old mechanical supervision, verified 3 mm backoff, the guarded review pose within the original budget, current exposure and restoration of native working optics before any action. A prefix 9 or 10 permits only the existing guarded closed withdrawal to the immutable ready pose, without requiring shaft markers in the narrow image or the obsolete legacy progress >=9 mm gate. Positive BELOW permits returning to ALIGN only with a fresh valid full work-view marker/front and original alignment and sweep checks. Unknown fails closed without another closure. No recovery may park without terminal evidence.
scoring: Use strict purpose-tagged SeamTruth only for the original independent scoring and safety/strain/grasp boundaries, never as a visual feature. Require accepted fresh guarded closures followed by post-closure reacquisition, no faults/tear/excess beyond 10 mm, explanatory optical withdrawal event, and closed jaws both before withdrawal and at the measured ready pose. Nominal first; run the registered 0.5 mm noise, occlusion_transient, slip_regrasp and relax cases only after nominal meets these criteria.
